pecas.prompt: A friendly cartoon alligator lying low on four short legs, with a very long flat snout closed in a wide smile showing a row of small white teeth, a round eye on top of its head, a bumpy ridged green back and a long tapering tail stretched out behind it, its body much longer than it is tall. Soft matte clay 3D illustration, children's storybook style, rich saturated colours, soft shadows. The whole animal is inside the frame from the tip of its snout to the tip of its tail, centred, seen straight from the side, filling about three quarters of the image width. Soft even studio light coming from the upper left, gentle contact shadow directly under the object. The animal floats alone on a plain, perfectly flat, bright magenta background (#FF00FF), with clear empty margin on all four sides. Every surface is smooth, blank and unmarked. The image contains only the object itself. Modelled in soft matte clay, like a children's storybook toy.
